notes: Browser layout suites used all three experimental motion settings together, the delivered CDN font configuration, and the external hourly-data build. Each browser covered 128 font/numeral/division/time combinations, settings migration/reload, geometry, and regression checks.
Detailed basic-symbol, structural-symbol and arithmetic-morph tests were run in Chromium for all eight font/numeral combinations.
Fira oldstyle has a zero wider than one small-clock cell. The whole small clock is scaled uniformly to a maximum 480-unit digit width, keeping all six digit centers and both colon centers fixed.
Euler oldstyle selects a larger radical for a sum than for a literal. The motion test uses a product to check same-size radical reuse, and a fraction to check size replacement.
The existing Euler extension metadata warning (component 4.0.0 with MathJax 4.1.3) remains visible. Data-failure warnings in the layout suites are deliberate fault injections.
The final build and Node suite ran with Node 22.17.1. Its external HTML matches the browser-tested output; the embedded gzip payload was rebuilt with Node 22.
